why: Part 3 salaries tax (charge s 8, with s 8(2)(cb) excluding MPF accrued benefits attributable to mandatory contributions; deductions s 12; calculation s 13); Part 4A concessionary deductions, including s 26G for MPF mandatory contributions capped by Schedule 3B; Part 5 allowances (ss 27-33); Part 7 personal assessment; Schedule 1 standard rate (from 2024/25 for salaries tax: 15% on the first $5,000,000, 16% on the remainder), Schedule 2 progressive rates, Schedule 4 allowance amounts, and the year-by-year tax-reduction Schedules. The XML carries the historical rate and allowance tables back to 1947/48, which accounts for its size.
